dedupe_keys.name: emsx dataset photovoltaic and load profiles with forecasts for 70 industrial sites schneider electric

description: EMSx is a large collection of photovoltaic generation and electricity load profiles from 70 anonymised industrial sites, collected by Schneider Electric and released as part of the EMSx benchmark for energy management systems. The Zenodo record says each site file has one line per 15-minute timestep with the measured PV production and consumption and Schneider Electric's historical forecasts for the next 96 steps (24 hours) of load and PV, plus a PV file and site metadata; the benchmark is described in a companion Energy Systems article. It was published on 15 September 2021 by Adrien Le Franc (Ecole des Ponts ParisTech) and Marc Ittel (Efficacity) as 72 files of about 6.2 GB (gzipped CSV), free to download under the Open Database Licence (ODbL). Coverage is 70 industrial sites whose locations are not given. Caveats: sites are anonymised, and the time span per site is not stated in the part of the record read. For simulation it gives real site load and PV traces with operational forecasts, to test microgrid control, battery dispatch and how industrial sites ride through grid disruptions. Related catalogue records include the VEA industrial load profiles and the KIT industrial demand-side flexibility benchmark.
